headline_seed: Lindsay Clancy trial ends earlier than expected Wednesday due to "unforeseen circumstance" - CBS News
draft_text:
Defense psychologist Dr. Paul Zeizel testified Wednesday in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial that Clancy, 36, heard a voice ordering her to kill her three children and had "no appreciation for the wrongfulness" of her acts. ABC News and CBS News both confirm.

And that's the mews.
